A5-110.axis: residual Western and Central European modern painters (born c. 1860–1944) not placed in a movement leaf; grouped by country of activity in a fixed west-to-east order (France, Low Countries, Britain and Ireland, German-speaking lands, Italy, Iberia, Nordic countries, Central and Eastern Europe, Balkans, then the Americas and elsewhere); within each country, named local schools, groups and colonies come first in order of their members' median birth (e.g. Bande noire, Seiz Breur, Worpswede, Gruppe 33, De Ploeg, Corrente, Halmstad Group), then the country group itself, split by generation of birth where it exceeds 150 artists; by birth within each group
A5-110.defn: Painters born c. 1860–1944 active in Europe (and a few in the Americas) whose work is modern but who belong to no movement with its own leaf here; artists of a named movement (Fauvism, Cubism, Expressionism, Surrealism, Vienna Secession, Novecento Italiano, St Ives School ...) are listed in that leaf instead. Small named groups without a leaf of their own are kept as sections.
